thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — running a small owner-claim & admin tidy next Tue. Need alignment on the snapshot artifact and rollback path.
trent: SG. I propose: dry-run -> artifact collect -> 2-project canary -> sampled rollback test -> wider sweep.
olga: For artifacts include project IAM, KMS key IAM, and bucket/object ACLs. We should GPG-sign the tarball and store sha256.
maya: Can you paste minimal commands?
olga: ```bash
# project IAM
gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJ --format=json > $PROJ-iam.json
# KMS key policy
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/$PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/$KR/cryptoKeys/$KEY --format=json > $KEY-iam.json
# bucket ACLs (AWS example)
aws s3api get-bucket-acl --bucket $BUCKET > $BUCKET-acl.json
# manifest + sign
sha256sum *.json > manifest.sha256
tar czf evidence-$PRINCIPAL.tar.gz *.json manifest.sha256
ngpg --detach-sign evidence-$PRINCIPAL.tar.gz
mc cp evidence-$PRINCIPAL.tar.gz s3://compliance-archive/$RUN_ID/
```
trent: Add a note: include notification history (Slack thread URL or message excerpts) inside the tarball. Legal wants an explicit statement in the ticket about hashing and retention.
ops: We'll enable a guard flag in infra-agent for the canary so deploys referencing removed roles fail with clear errors. Ops will also run smoke tests and have `rebind-temp --principal X --ttl 1h` ready.
maya: legal, confirm retention and signing format?
legal: GPG detached signature + sha256 manifest acceptable. Retain for 7 years, and set bucket ACLs to compliance-only. Also need ticket reference in artifact metadata.
